text:
Nina (Marketing): Final check  run-of-show + rehearsal slots for next Wed 'Delivering Predictable Inference'. Need: abstracts locked, speaker order, stage ops backchannel, slide sync, live demo fallback, and poll question.

Ethan (Events): Room & backstage reserved. Green room opens 30m before. We have 3 rehearsal slots: Tue 10:00, Tue 15:00, Wed 08:30. Which do we take?

Ravi (Product): Tues 15:00 works for speakers. We'll rehearse demo + Q&A handoff. Abstracts are in the doc: https://docs.google.com/abc - small edits needed on the third paragraph (clarify net unit-cost claim).

Lena (Design): I'll sync slides tonight and export master deck. Also making a 4-slide spoiler deck for social.

Tom (Eng): Demo note: include a recorded fallback clip (60s) showing the model serving pipeline + batching config in case live system spikes. I can produce that Wed morning.

Clare (Sales): Can we add a 15m office hours block post-webinar for qualified leads? Means schedule link + calendar widget in follow-up. Sales ops prefers 15m quick calls.

Nina (Marketing): Yes on office hours. Draft run-of-show below. Please call out timing if it's tight.

Nina (Marketing): ```
18:00 - Welcome (2m) - host open, housekeeping
18:02 - Keynote (10m) - market context + thesis
18:12 - Product demo (12m) - Ravi + Tom (live)
18:24 - Benchmarks & economics (8m) - Ravi
18:32 - Customer case (6m) - Clare (pre-recorded)
18:38 - Live Q&A (15m) - panel + audience
18:53 - Close & CTAs (7m) - book office hours / download benchmark pdf
```

Ethan (Events): Timing looks tight on demo -> benchmarks handoff. Recommend 2 extra minutes for mic swap. Can we shorten keynote to 8m?

Ravi (Product): I can tighten keynote to 8m if we remove one slide. Will do.

Lena (Design): Slide handoff protocol: presenters upload final deck to GDrive by Tue 20:00. I'll consolidate and add slide numbers + speaker notes.

Tom (Eng): Demo run checklist (short):
- Confirm model pinned to x.y.
- Start local serving stack 
- Pre-warm KV cache
- Run smoke prompt sequence
I'll paste a small script in the rehearsal.

Tom (Eng): ```bash
# smoke prompts for rehearsal
python run_demo.py --prompts prompts/smoke.txt --model x.y --warm-cache True
```

Clare (Sales): Poll idea during Q&A: "Which inference priority matters most to you? (latency / cost / data isolation / reliability)" Will help routing.

Nina (Marketing): Good. Add as single-select poll at minute 40 (start of Q&A). Also plan a 1-sentence survey at close: "Primary reason you attended?"

Ethan (Events): Backchannel: we'll use Slack channel #webinar-backstage. stagebot will post join links. stagebot: please confirm the channel has access.

stagebot: #webinar-backstage created and invite links sent to participants. Recording enabled.

Ravi (Product): Contingency plan: If live demo fails, Tom runs the 60s fallback clip and we continue with benchmarks. We'll surface exact error and offer a deep-dive follow-up for affected viewers.

Lena (Design): For social clips: 30s hero, 45s demo highlight, 15s CTA. Need timestamps from rehearsal to clip.

Nina (Marketing): Owners summary: Rehearsal coordination = Ethan; Slides + assets = Lena; Demo + fallback clip = Tom; Benchmarks narrative = Ravi; Office hours scheduling + lead CTA = Clare; Poll + survey = Nina.

Clare (Sales): I'll prepare a short booking copy and pass to Nina by Tue noon.

Ethan (Events): Rehearsal invite sent to speakers for Tue 15:00. Please RSVP.

Tom (Eng): RSVP'd. Will upload fallback clip Wed 08:00 if all good.

Ravi (Product): I'll update the benchmark paragraph and add test-bed details (seq len, batch shape, GPU type) in the doc.

Nina (Marketing): Thanks all. Quick callout: please refrain from adding new slides after Tue 20:00 unless critical. Closing thread, will follow up in #webinar-backstage. :thumbsup:
